purpose: Problem-family assimilation routines for M2D-SBA-07 after concept teaching and before Revised Core (2) transfer.

transfer_routines.title: Horizontal-launch clock and impact state
recognition_signals: horizontal launch from a known height
a ratio between vertical and horizontal velocity components may be given

method_steps.title: Let vertical motion set the event time
method_steps.learner_move: Use h=1/2 gt^2 or the signed vertical equation.

method_steps.title: Use the same time in x and velocity equations
Finish the requested state
method_steps.learner_move: Use Pythagoras, direction geometry or the given component ratio.

independent_practice.prompt: A ball is launched horizontally at 12 m/s from a height of 20 m. Take g=10 m/s^2. Find fall time, horizontal distance and impact speed.
independent_practice.answer_check: t=2 s; x=24 m; |v_y|=20 m/s; impact speed=4sqrt(34) m/s.

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: For a horizontal launch, vertical launch velocity is zero and the drop determines the time.

readiness_checks: write u_y=0, v_x=u_x and the vertical event equation
find t from vertical motion without H2/H3
finish x and impact velocity for a fresh problem
transfer_routines.release_rule: Release Q03, Q29 and Q42 after 4/4 readiness without H2/H3.

transfer_routines.title: Target, geometry and displacement
recognition_signals: target coordinate or point is given

method_steps.title: Draw the displacement triangle
method_steps.learner_move: Mark Delta x and signed Delta y from launch to target.

method_steps.title: Use geometry before dynamics when possible
Find the event time vertically
method_steps.learner_move: Use the vertical drop or signed y-equation.

method_steps.title: Finish with x=u_x t and vector geometry
method_steps.learner_move: Keep displacement distinct from path length.

independent_practice.prompt: A target is 20 m below and 30 m horizontally from a launch point. A ball is projected horizontally and hits it. Take g=10 m/s^2. Find required horizontal speed and displacement magnitude.
independent_practice.answer_check: t=2 s; u_x=15 m/s; displacement=10sqrt(13) m.

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: The target fixes both horizontal and vertical displacement; the vertical drop sets the available time.

hint_ladder.label: Representation
hint_ladder.prompt: Use 20=1/2(10)t^2 and 30=u_x t; displacement is sqrt(30^2+20^2).

readiness_checks: draw Delta x and Delta y before calculating
use vertical drop to set time without H2/H3
finish launch speed or displacement while distinguishing path length
transfer_routines.release_rule: Release Q04, Q08 and Q36 after 4/4 readiness.

transfer_routines.title: Unequal-height signed vertical motion
recognition_signals: upward or downward initial vertical component is present

method_steps.title: Assign signed vertical quantities
method_steps.learner_move: Give u_y, a_y and Delta y signs from the chosen axis.

method_steps.title: Solve the actual landing equation
method_steps.learner_move: Use Delta y=u_y t-1/2 gt^2 or y=y0+u_y t-1/2 gt^2.

method_steps.title: Take the physical root then use horizontal motion
method_steps.learner_move: Reject negative elapsed time and use the same positive t horizontally.

independent_practice.prompt: A projectile leaves a platform with u_x=8 m/s and u_y=+5 m/s. Ground is 10 m below launch. Take g=10 m/s^2. Find landing time and horizontal distance.

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: Same-height flight-time shortcuts do not apply; use the actual signed landing equation.

readiness_checks: write the actual landing equation without a same-height shortcut
take the physical root and finish x-motion
transfer_routines.release_rule: Release Q09 and Q30 after 4/4 readiness.

transfer_routines.title: Opposite horizontal launches and separation
recognition_signals: two horizontal launches start from the same height
motions are in opposite horizontal directions

method_steps.title: Use the shared vertical drop
method_steps.learner_move: Recognise identical vertical motion and one common fall time.

independent_practice.prompt: Two balls are launched horizontally in opposite directions from a point 45 m above ground with speeds 6 m/s and 10 m/s. Take g=10 m/s^2. Find their separation just before landing.

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: Both objects have the same vertical motion and therefore the same fall time.

readiness_checks: draw both horizontal directions and common drop
find the common fall time first
